body:
## Summary
This PR implements W12-Training-1 (#148) by adding a reproducible SFT/QLoRA baseline training pipeline, fixed configs, and RC Gate-A artifacts generation.

Closes #148

## Changes
- Added `scripts/run_w12_issue148_sft_qlora.py`
  - Loads frozen dataset splits from `output/dataset_v1/...`
  - Supports tool-priority stratified sampling (`sampling.allowed_priorities`)
  - Runs LoRA training and enables QLoRA automatically when `bitsandbytes` is available
  - Writes model package manifest + checksums + model card + training summary + smoke inference logs
  - Records per-tool slice stats (`loss/sample_ratio/failure_ratio`)
  - Validates adapter reload for smoke inference
- Added configs:
  - `configs/training/w12_issue148_sft_qlora_p0_only.json`
  - `configs/training/w12_issue148_sft_qlora_p0_p1.json`
- Added runbook:
  - `scripts/w12-issue-148-sft-qlora-baseline.md`
- Added unit tests:
  - `tests/unit/test_run_w12_issue148_sft_qlora.py`

## Validation
- Unit tests:
  - `uv run pytest tests/unit/test_run_w12_issue148_sft_qlora.py -q`
- End-to-end runs (local output artifacts):
  - `uv run --with torch==2.8.0 --with transformers==4.57.0 --with peft==0.17.1 --with accelerate==1.11.0 --with datasets==4.3.0 --with bitsandbytes==0.48.1 python scripts/run_w12_issue148_sft_qlora.py --config configs/training/w12_issue148_sft_qlora_p0_only.json`
  - `uv run --with torch==2.8.0 --with transformers==4.57.0 --with peft==0.17.1 --with accelerate==1.11.0 --with datasets==4.3.0 --with bitsandbytes==0.48.1 python scripts/run_w12_issue148_sft_qlora.py --config configs/training/w12_issue148_sft_qlora_p0_p1.json`

## Acceptance Criteria Check (#148)
- [x] Training flow reproducible via fixed config + explicit command
- [x] Model artifact can be loaded and smoke inference is executed
- [x] Hyperparameters + environment are fully logged
- [x] RC Gate-A artifacts generated:
  - model package manifest
  - checksums
  - minimal model card
  - candidate version naming (`v0.3.0-rc1`)
- [x] Requirement-2 merge items covered:
  - tool-stratified sampling params
  - P0-only / P0+P1 config pair
  - per-tool training slice stats
  - tool coverage section in model card

## Notes
- Output artifacts are generated under `output/training/w12-issue-148/...` and are intentionally not committed (repo ignore rules).
- With current frozen dataset, selected samples are concentrated in P0 slice; this is captured transparently in the training summary.
